Its only entrance is a small bridge connected to the Village of Beginnings, which is currently destroyed by a waterfall. Only the most powerful Digimon, as well as those who are affected most heavily by the berserk, resides in the mountain.

Back Dimension.description: The Back Dimension is the leftover traces of Mugendramon once it is defeated at Infinity Mountain, and can take the place of either Ice Sanctuary, Dark Lord Mansion, or Orge Fortress, one at a time. Each Back Dimension consists of three levels, and its appearance is very similar to that of the interior of Infinity Mountain. Once the Player reaches the final level, he will find that the location is no longer Back Dimension, but the original location.

Net Ocean.name: Net Ocean
Net Ocean.introduce: The Net Ocean (ネットの海, Netto no Umi; also ネットオーシャン, Netto Ōshan) is the Network's ocean[1]; a large body of water that surrounds the Digital World. It is the birthplace of Digimon, with Ancient Mermaimon acting as its guardian goddess, ruling the whole of it and able to handle all water, such as the ocean currents and tidal waves, as if they were its own limbs.[2] It consists of a range of biomes, and is inhabited by various aquatic Digimon[3][4][5][6][7], even in places of high water pressure within its deepest trenches[8]. The Dark Web is the deepest part of the Net Ocean that is the nearest to the Dark Area.[9][10] Some aquatic Digimon were discovered in it. It is where Ganimon dissolved metal data and stuck it to its body,[11] rapidly enhancing its combat ability, and its bottom is the source of Octmon's Digi-Treasure.[12] Coelamon was also discovered here when the Computer Network was being repaired.[13]  There are a few Aquatic Digimon that are extremely rare to encounter, such as Manbomon  and Marin Angemon.[14][15] Hookmon ventures through it, pursuing the phantom White Whamon.[16].  Mermaimon's looted treasure is said to reside somewhere in the Net Ocean.[17] Giga Seadramon is said to patrol the Net Ocean for the Crack Team, though it is not known when and where it will appear.[18]

Piccolomon's Forest.introduce: Piccolomon's Forest (ピッコロモンの森 Pikkoromon no Mori) is an area in the Server Continent. It is surrounded by a barrier created by Piccolomon, and thus, invisible from outside. It can only be entered or exited by portals created by Piccolomon himself. Outside of one, which linked to the desert, is a well that contains the Crests of Friendship and Knowledge.

Pyocomon Village.name: Pyocomon Village
Pyocomon Village.introduce: Pyocomon Village (ピョコモンの村 Pyokomon no Mura) is located in Gear Savannah of File Island, and is home to many Pyocomon.

Spiral Mountain.name: Spiral Mountain
Spiral Mountain.introduce: Spiral Mountain (スパイラルマウンテン Supairaru Mauntin) is the form the Digital World took after the Dark Masters transformed it into a large mountain when the Chosen Children travelled to the Real World to fight Vamdemon. It was divided into four sections, each led by one of the Dark Masters. After each of them were defeated, their respective sections returned to normal, with Spiral Mountain fully disappearing after Piemon's defeat.

Digital Ocean.name: Digital Ocean
Digital Ocean.description: The Digital Ocean is ruled by Metal Seadramon and is protected by an Anomalocarimon and legions of Hangyomon. It is where the Chosen Children arrived after they were saved by Piccolomon. After traveling through the ocean with the help of Whamon, the children ended up in a small lake. Whamon sacrificed his life to protect the children and then War Greymon was able to kill Metal Seadramon with his Brave Tornado attack, destroying him and returning the ocean to normal.

Digital Forest.name: Digital Forest
Digital Forest.description: The forest section is controlled by Pinocchimon from his mansion. The forest floor can be rearranged by Pinocchimon's remote control. He also has small voodoo dolls that control the Chosen Children's movements and location throughout the forest. When Takaishi Takeru was playing with Pinocchimon inside his mansion, he was able to destroy the remote and take the dolls. Later Metal Garurumon destroyed Pinocchimon and the land he controlled faded from Spiral Mountain.

Digital City.introduce: Digital City (デジタル･シティ Dejitaru Shiti) is a location in Directory Continent.

Wasteland.name: Wasteland
Wasteland.description: The wasteland was ruled by Piemon on top of Spiral Mountain. His bodyguard was Lady Devimon and had an army of Evilmon under his control. When Piemon was sealed in Holy Angemon's Heaven's Gate, the remaining part of Spiral Mountain returned to normal.

Village of Beginnings.description: The Village of Beginnings is the main city of File Island, located on the center of the island. There are many buildings in the city, and in Digimon World it leads to Infinity Mountain and Unwavering Forest.

Wall of Fire.name: Wall of Fire
Wall of Fire.introduce: The Wall of Fire is a wall described in the prophecy inscribed in the Ancient Dino Region's ancient ruins. According to the prophecy, Apocalymon came through that Wall of Fire and almost destroyed the Digital World. The original Chosen Children came to defeat him. However, it was said that he would come through the wall once again, and so the 1999 group of children was chosen to defeat him.

World Tree.name: World Tree
World Tree.introduce: The World Tree (世界樹, Sekaiju) is an avatar created by Yggdrasill that supports the Digital World.

Mirror World.name: Mirror World
Mirror World.introduce: The Mirror World (ミラーワールド, Mirā Wārudo) is a parallel world in Digimon Beatbreak. It is a collection of digital planes that exist within the Network to whom Digimon can enter from the Real World via Rifts. It's possible to travel between them & reality by passing through the cracks.
Mirror World.description: The Mirror World is vast landscape with a cybernetic aesthetic. The air is spattered with floating cubes which represent various landscapes that can be entered by a Digimon, such as a crowded forest or a labyrinthine, looping roadway, landscape comprised of a virtual sky, a chequered ground and numerous floating cubes. Each cube has their own theme which seems to apply advantage to some Digimon.

Shangri-La Egg.name: Shangri-La Egg
Shangri-La Egg.introduce: The Shangri-La Egg is the U-topian center of the city in Digimon Beatbreak. This building was built to withstand floods, earthquakes and other potential disasters and located around the Hikarigahama East.[1]
Shangri-La Egg.description: Given it's namesake, the building is a egg-shaped giant-sized that keeps residents at a high level. Entering the building would require to go through an Sapotama Scan Spot outside upon the entrance. It offers many things besides homes for the people that live inside the building like the High-End Block, from shopping places that required with One Day Passports to an observation tower. Even a gardening area above the top of the building where Klay Arslan lives. Registring in the building would be cross-referenced in each Area Block and anyone with a criminal record or those who have unauthorized access through this places will be punished and prevented from entry. The building also includes a janitor directory and worker drones that deliver anything from the Sapotamas via user.

Bloody Castle.name: Bloody Castle
Bloody Castle.introduce: Bloody Castle (城血液 Shiro Ketsueki), is a castle ruled by Grand Dracumon in Digimon Collectors.
Bloody Castle.description: Ofanimon was trying to find research report information in the castle, but ended up being corrupted by Grand Dracumon during the events of the game. Later on, Seraphimon was corrupted by Dracumon due to a joke that he was trying to do with Omekamon.

Dark Forest.description: A huge hole appeared in the "Dark Forest" and is said to connect with the "World of Insects", the "Under Forest" where Ancient Beatmon is hidden.

Dark Research Island.description: This place is one of the mysterious laboratories in the game. There Vamdemon, with help from Devimon and Etemon, tried to break a seal of a gate to the Real World using Arkadimon's Digitama. Ancient Sphinxmon was there for unknown reasons.

Phantom Mirror Library.introduce: Phantom Mirror Library (幻鏡の図書館 Genkyō no Toshokan), is a location in Digimon Collectors.
Phantom Mirror Library.description: A mysterious place that seems to travel between worlds due to the "Phantom Mirror" (Ancient Wisemon) that connects this world with another one. The library appears after huge sandstorms and always in different places.

Thorn Castle.description: This castle is ruled by Algomon. It's the source of a phenomenon that was causing Digimon to sleep. The thorns are capable of destroying the data of the Digimon that touched them. Ancient Troiamon was able to resist it and helped tamers to invade the castle

Wandering Island.name: Wandering Island
Wandering Island.introduce: The Wandering Island (さまよえる島, Samayoeru Shima) is a mysterious floating island, which travels across the dimensions of the Digital World and exists outside of the regular spacetime of the Digital World.
Wandering Island.description: The island is shaped like a wheel and consists of a central, stepped landmass with five outlying sections connected to each other and the central section by thin bridges. The human shaped digimon and beast shaped digimon have their own villages on the far opposite sides of the island (which is surprisingly small). The central portion contains an ancient, crumbling ruin where Ornismon was sealed away. Unlike the ordinary Digital World, the space-time is the time after Lucemon was defeated by the Warrior Ten, but before the Three Archangels were in charge too. Ornismon is known as the guardian deity of the island.[1] The island also has the curious ability to pass through various points of the Digital World's structure, making it difficult to track, let alone get on or escape from. It has been shown to be able to phase through solid ground.

Factorial Town.introduce: Factorial Town (ファクトリアルタウン Fakutoriaru Taun) is a city in the Gear Savannah on File Island.
Factorial Town.description: Factorial Town is a factory town that builds up machine and then takes them apart again. It has a dock on its western side, its main gate on the southern side leading to Gear Savannah, and is heavily guarded by various Digimon.

Fighters.text:

Piemon

High-Rise Colosseum.introduce: The High-Rise Colosseum (ハイライズ・コロシアム Hairaizu Koroshiamu) is a location in the Digital World: Iliad in Digimon Story: Time Stranger.

Gear Forest.name: Gear Forest

Gear Forest.introduce: Gear Forest (ギア・フォレスト Gia Foresuto) is a forest in the Digital World: Iliad in Digimon Story: Time Stranger.

Guardian Palace.name: Guardian Palace

Minor characters (pre-timeskip).text: Various Baby or Baby II Digimon living around the Palace gates

Imprisoned during the 8-year timeskip.text: Tunomon and Dorimon (freed off-screen by other Titans before the Agent, Dianamon and Apollomon were involved)
Greymon -- Unlike the ones above, Greymon was moved out of the prison for unknown purposes before the jailbreak occurred. The Greymon's color is also not stated.

Guardian Palace.introduce: Guardian Palace (ガーディアンパレス Gādian Paresu), is a location in the Digital World: Iliad in Digimon Story: Time Stranger. It is Junomon's residence and is defended by Angel-type Digimon. The landmark known as the Temple of Iliad (イリアス神殿 Iriasu Shinden) is located within this area.

Temple of Beginnings.name: Temple of Beginnings
Temple of Beginnings.introduce: Temple of Beginnings (はじまりの神殿 Hajimari no Shinden), is a location in the Digital World: Iliad in Digimon Story: Time Stranger and a part of the Guardian Palace. Aegiomon's Digitama was housed here.

Outer Dungeons.name: Outer Dungeons
Outer Dungeons.introduce: The Outer Dungeons (アウターダンジョン Autā Danjon) are special areas in Digimon Story: Time Stranger. They are areas within phase electron space that are scattered across the world. According to Minervamon, they exist between the Real World and Digital World: Iliad.

Rebellion Village.name: Rebellion Village

Kanji/Kana.content: リベリオン ・ビレッジ

Rebellion Village.introduce: Rebellion Village (リベリオン ・ビレッジ Riberion Birejji) is a village built in the Real World with the remains of Central Town in Digimon Story: Time Stranger.

Shinjuku Underground Arena.name: Shinjuku Underground Arena

Kanji/Kana.content: 新宿アンダーアリーナ

Shinjuku Underground Arena.introduce: The Shinjuku Underground Arena (新宿アンダーアリーナ Shinjuku Andā Arīna) is a location in the Real World in Digimon Story: Time Stranger.

Threshold Theater.name: Threshold Theater
Threshold Theater.introduce: The Threshold Theater (狭間劇場 Hazama Gekijō, Dub: In-Between Theater), also known as the Threshold Theater of Time (時の狭間劇場 Toki no Hazama Gekijō, Dub: In-Between Theater of Time), is a venue located between different dimensions in Digimon Story: Time Stranger.

Wall of Hope.name: Wall of Hope
Wall of Hope.introduce: The Wall of Hope (きぼうの壁 Kibō no Kabe), is a massive government-built wall in Shinjuku that surrounds a mysterious government building, ostensibly for public safety. The wall is covered up by the Japanese government, and beneath it, people are protesting to get the government to reveal the truth behind its existence.

Appmon Academy.name: Appmon Academy
Appmon Academy.introduce: The Appmon Academy (アプモン学園 "Apumon Gakuen"?) is the main setting of Appli Monsters: Appmon Academy!!. It is a school for Appmon located in the Net Ocean.

Appmon Cemetery.name: Appmon Cemetery
Appmon Cemetery.introduce: Appmon Cemetery (アプモン墓場, Apumon Hakaba) is a legendary place where obsolete Appmon are sent.

Beauty Palace.name: Beauty Palace
Beauty Palace.introduce: Beauty Palace (ビューティパレス, Byūti Paresu) is Beautymon's stronghold.

Bi Royal Palace.name: Bi Royal Palace
Bi Royal Palace.introduce: Bi Royal Palace (バイ王宮, Bai Ōkyū) is Biomon's stronghold.

Calendar World.name: Calendar World
Calendar World.introduce: Calendar World (暦の世界, Koyomi no Sekai) is Calendamon's cyber realm.

Chaos AR-Field.name: Chaos AR-Field
Chaos AR-Field.introduce: Chaos AR-Field (カオスＡＲフィールド, Kaosu AR Fīrudo) is an especially dangerous class of AR-Field triggered by the appearance of the Chaos Gates around the Real World. Due to their influence, communications in the Cyber Arena have been affected. It is later revealed that Appmon that come into contact with them become infected and receive a power boost, ultimately running wild as a consequence.

Charisma Castle.name: Charisma Castle
Charisma Castle.introduce: Charisma Castle (カリスマ城, Karisuma Jō) is Charismon's stronghold.

Cyber Arena.name: Cyber Arena
Cyber Arena.introduce: Cyber Arena (サイバーアリーナ, Saibā Arīna) is an area that appears in Digimon Universe Appli Monsters where several tournaments take place.

Cyber Kowloon.name: Cyber Kowloon
Cyber Kowloon.introduce: Cyber Kowloon (サイバー九龍, Saibā Kyūryū), also known as simply Kowloon (九龍, Kyūryū) is an area located within the Deep Web.

Dante Gate Entrance.name: Dante Gate Entrance

Kanji/Kana.content: ダンテゲートエントランス

Dante Gate Entrance.introduce: Dante Gate Entrance (ダンテゲートエントランス, Dante Gēto Entoransu) is an area that connects the Surface Web to the Deep Web.

Dark Web (Appmon).name: Dark Web (Appmon)
Dark Web (Appmon).introduce: The Dark Web (ダークウェブ, Dāku Webu) is the deepest layer of the Net Ocean. By using its abilities, Globemon is able to reach even the very bottom of the Dark Web.[1] Leviathan resides in the Dark Web.

Deep Web.name: Deep Web
Deep Web.introduce: The Deep Web (ディープウェブ, Dīpu Webu) is under the Surface Web. It is connected to the Surface Web through a door in the Dante Gate Entrance. Located within the Deep Web is Cyber Kowloon, a vast digital city inhabited by Appmon and ruled over by Leviathan.

Desert (Appmon).name: Desert (Appmon)
Desert (Appmon).introduce: Desert (砂漠, Sabaku) is an area that connects the AR-Field with the Net Ocean in Digimon Universe Appli Monsters.

Fujimizaka.name: Fujimizaka
Fujimizaka.introduce: Fujimizaka (ふじみ坂, Fujimi-zaka) is a fictional city in Tokyo and the main setting of Digimon Universe Appli Monsters. Its name is derived from "fujimizaka" (富士見坂), a Japanese expression that refers to hills from where Mount Fuji is visible.

Hifumigaoka Peripheral Region.name: Hifumigaoka Peripheral Region
Hifumigaoka Peripheral Region.introduce: The Hifumigaoka Peripheral Region (ヒフミヶ丘周辺地域, Hifumigaoka Shūhen Chiiki) is the main setting of Digimon Universe Appli Monsters (3DS). It is a region that encompasses the four towns of Hifumigaoka, Yongendōri, Nikotamagawa, and Mihamakou, from west to east. The towns' names are derived from the numbers "one", "two", "three", and "four" after the order in which they appear in the game.

Kashinoki Bookstore.name: Kashinoki Bookstore
Kashinoki Bookstore.introduce: Kashinoki Bookstore (樫の木書店, Kashinoki Shoten) is the home of Kashiki Ai and her father which doubles as a bookstore. It is open from 10:00 to 20:00. The bookstore is the location on a rare treasure in the game L-Treasure, and as such is visited by many players.

L-Town.name: L-Town
L-Town.introduce: L-Town (Ｌタウン, L-Taun) is the world's first model town that is managed by artificial intelligence created by L-Corp.

Nakano Broadway.name: Nakano Broadway
Nakano Broadway.introduce: Nakano Broadway (中野ブロードウェイ, Nakano Burōdowei), also known by the name Nakano Broadstreet (中野ブロードストリート, Nakano Burōdosutorīto) in the Digimon Universe Appli Monsters continuity, is a shopping center with a retro atmosphere located a few minutes from Shinjuku, west of central Tokyo, known for housing stores dedicated to anime, manga and Japanese pop culture.

Net Ocean (Appmon).name: Net Ocean (Appmon)
Net Ocean (Appmon).introduce: The Net Ocean (ネットの海 "Netto no Umi"?) is the world where the Appmon come from. It is part of the backstory of Digimon Universe App Monsters, and is equivalent to the Internet.

Surface Web.name: Surface Web
Surface Web.introduce: The Surface Web (サーフェスウェブ, Sāfesu Webu) is the most surface part of the Net Ocean. It resembles an ocean, and is filled with many islands where each Appmon species live. The Net Ocean's islands are what humans call "servers".

Dark Web.name: Dark Web
Dark Web.introduce: The Dark Web (ダークウェブ, Dāku Webu) is the deepest part of the Net Ocean that is the nearest to the Dark Area.[1] Leviamon is reported to sleep there.[2]

Reviewmon Island.name: Reviewmon Island
Reviewmon Island.introduce: Reviewmon Island (レビューモンの島, Rebyūmon no Shima) is an island located within the Surface Web.

Sham Mansion.name: Sham Mansion
Sham Mansion.introduce: Sham Mansion (イカサマンション, Ikasa Manshon) is Fakemon's stronghold.

Shooting Island.name: Shooting Island
Shooting Island.introduce: Shooting Island (シューティング島, Shūtingu-jima) is an island located within the Surface Web.

Timemon Island.name: Timemon Island
Timemon Island.introduce: Timemon Island (タイムモンの島, Taimumon no Shima) is an island located within the Surface Web.

Virus Island.name: Virus Island
Virus Island.introduce: Virus Island (ウイルス島, Uirusu-jima) is an island located within the Surface Web.

Bagra Pandemonium.name: Bagra Pandemonium
Bagra Pandemonium.introduce: The Bagra Pandemonium (バグラ大魔殿, Bagura Daimaden), also known as Bagra Empire, is a Land within the Digital World. Originally it was an unnamed Zone where much of the Bagra army resided.
Bagra Pandemonium.description: The Pandemonium is a massive landmass within the Digital World surrounded by seven other Lands.

Bright Land.name: Bright Land
Bright Land.introduce: Bright Land (ブライト ランド Buraito Rando) is a Land within the Digital World.

Hell's Field.name: Hell's Field
Hell's Field.introduce: Hell's Field (ヘルズフィールド Heruzu Fīrudo) (Dub: Digital Underworld) is a an area underneath Bright Land.
Hell's Field.description: Hell's Field is an area created underneath Bright Land. It contains countless hexagonal fields, each based on a different human interpretation of the underworld from various mythologies, with a white castle and black castle at either end of the field. All communications are disrupted within this area, minus the stones in each of the chess-themed castles.

Canyon Land.name: Canyon Land
Canyon Land.introduce: Canyon Land (キャニオンランド Kyanion Rando) is a Land within the Digital World.

Corridor Zone.name: Corridor Zone
Corridor Zone.introduce: The Corridor Zone (コリドーゾーン Koridō Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Corridor Zone.description: Little is known about the Corridor Zone, other than it appeared in one of Taiki's dreams. It seems to have some ruined, medieval architecture.

Cyber Land.name: Cyber Land
Cyber Land.introduce: Cyber Land (サイバーランド Saibā Rando) is a Land within the Digital World.

Digital Space.name: Digital Space
Digital Space.introduce: Digital Space refers to the empty area between Zones in the Digital World of Digimon Xros Wars. All Zones reside within this space, and it is exceedingly difficult to travel across it, as Digimon with smaller amounts of data or insufficiently protected forms will have their bodies begin to destabilize. Humans, however suffer no ill effects.

Disc Zone.name: Disc Zone
Disc Zone.introduce: The Disc Zone (ディスクゾーン Disuku Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.

Dragon Land.name: Dragon Land
Dragon Land.introduce: Dragon Land (ドラゴン ランド Doragon Rando) is a Land within the Digital World.
Dragon Land.description: Dragon Land is a combination of lush, flower-filled fields, mountains, and volcanic pools. It is inhabited by many plant and bird digimon and ruled over by aggressive Dragon type digimon.

Village of Smiles.name: Village of Smiles
Village of Smiles.introduce: Village of Smiles (微笑みの里  Hohoemi  no Sato), is a small village within Green Zone.

Dust Zone.name: Dust Zone

Dust Zone.text:
Trailmon
Trailmon Angler
Trailmon Buffalo
Trailmon Kettle
Trailmon Raccoon Dog
Trailmon Worm

Dust Zone.introduce: The Dust Zone (ダスト ゾーン Dasuto Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Dust Zone.description: The Dust Zone is the trash heap of the Digital World where all sorts of junk seems to find its way to. Towering heaps of garbage can be found everywhere and tracks used by Trailmon run everywhere. It is lorded over by Grand Locomon.

Forest Zone.name: Forest Zone
Forest Zone.introduce: The Forest Zone (フォレストゾーン Foresuto Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Forest Zone.description: The Forest Zone can best be described as a jungle-like habitat inhabited mostly by insect-types. It bears a great resemblance to Beetle Land.

Gold Land.name: Gold Land
Gold Land.introduce: Gold Land (ゴルド ランド Gorudo Rando) is a Land within the Digital World.
Gold Land.description: Gold Land is a vast sea peppered with islands, all colored golden. It was mentioned by Olegmon that the former Gold Zone makes up a portion of the newly formed land. Unlike the other Lands, the portal between them is actually underwater rather than in the sky; the only way for non-aquatic digimon to reach it is to use Olegmon's pirate ship.[1]

Gold Zone.name: Gold Zone
Gold Zone.introduce: The Gold Zone is a Zone within the Digital World.
Gold Zone.description: The Gold Zone was only seen in a flashback when mentioned as the previous home of the Death General Olegmon, and Dark Volumon. When the Zones were reformatted into Lands, the Gold Zone became a major part of Gold Land.[1]

Green Zone.name: Green Zone
Green Zone.introduce: The Green Zone (グリンゾーン Gurin Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Green Zone.description: The Green Zone consists mostly of open grasslands and forests, but possesses some shallow cliffs and bluffs.

Heaven Zone.name: Heaven Zone
Heaven Zone.introduce: The Heaven Zone (ヘブンゾーン Hebun Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Heaven Zone.description: The Heaven Zone is a land inhabited by various species of Holy Digimon, notably Cupimon and members of the Angemon-species.

Honey Land.name: Honey Land
Honey Land.introduce: Honey Land (ハニーランド Hanī Rando) is a Land within the Digital World.

Island Zone.name: Island Zone
Island Zone.introduce: The Island Zone (アイランドゾーン Airando Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Island Zone.description: The Island Zone is a tropical sea with a series of islands and beaches. It is inhabited by many ocean-faring digimon.

Jupiter Zone.name: Jupiter Zone
Jupiter Zone.introduce: The Jupiter Zone (ジュピターゾーン Jupitā Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Jupiter Zone.description: Juiter Zone is the headquarters of the Bagra Army. The Bagra Pandemonium is hidden in Cloud Canyon.

Lake Zone.name: Lake Zone
Lake Zone.introduce: The Lake Zone (レイクゾーン Reiku Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Lake Zone.description: The Lake Zone is a lush, temperate zone with a massive crystal lake. Across the lake from Bastia Castle are a long series of icy caverns.

LS-tou Zone.name: LS-tou Zone
LS-tou Zone.introduce: The LS-tou Zone (エルエストウゾーン Eruesutou Zōn, arguably a contraction for Lost Space Island Zone) is an area of the Digital World where special beings referred to as Weapon-type Digimon inhabit. This country is exposed terrain for invading armies, but the Digimon living in the area are unable to properly defend it while in their natural shapes. As a result, they acquired the unique ability to turn their own bodies into gigantic, peerless weapons that can then be wielded by another Digimon, substantially increasing their might.

Sky Fort.name: Sky Fort
Sky Fort.introduce: Sky Fort (スカイフォート  Sukai Fōto), is a location in LS-tou Zone that serves as the base of operations for the Xros Heart.

Magma Zone.name: Magma Zone
Magma Zone.introduce: The Magma Zone is a mountainous region littered with active volcanoes and hot springs. It is inhabited primarily by rock-like and mammalian Digimon.
Magma Zone.description: The Magma Zone is a mountainous region littered with active volcanoes and hot springs. It is inhabited primarily by rock-like and mammalian Digimon.

Prison Land.name: Prison Land
Prison Land.introduce: The Prison Land (プリズンランド, Purizon Rando) is an eight hidden Land, a spiritual dimension where Dark Knightmon sent and imprisoned the souls of Shoutmon, Ballistamon, and Dorulumon, as well as the souls of the seven Death Generals. In a last ditch effort, Kudou Taiki let Dark Knightmon send his own soul there, in an attempt to break his friends out.

Pyramid of Revival.name: Pyramid of Revival
Pyramid of Revival.introduce: The Pyramid of Revival 「復活のピラミッド Fukkatsu no Piramiddo」 is a gigantic floating pyramid that appears in Sand Zone.

Rain Zone.name: Rain Zone
Rain Zone.introduce: The Rain Zone (レインゾーン Rein Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Rain Zone.description: Rain Zone is a land of constant rain. It is said that the rain gathers together the tears that flow in the Digital World, and continues to fall incessantly. In this area there is Dark Knightmon's fortress, the Dark Crystal Palace.

River Zone.name: River Zone
River Zone.introduce: The River Zone (ゾーン  Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.

Sandoria.name: Sandoria
Sandoria.introduce: Sandoria 「サンドリア Sandoria」 was a prosperous city protected by the The Goddess' Warriors in Sand Zone.

Sand Zone.name: Sand Zone
Sand Zone.introduce: The Sand Zone ( サンドゾーン Sando Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Sand Zone.description: The Sand Zone is a massive desert area littered with pyramids and ancient ruins. While being hot and rather inhospitable, the Sand Zone was once home to a thriving civilization and possesses several underground waterways. The Zone is also rich in minerals.

Shinobi Zone.name: Shinobi Zone
Shinobi Zone.introduce: The Shinobi Zone (シノビゾーン Shinobi Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Shinobi Zone.description: The Shinobi Zone possesses a lot of classical Japanese architecture and giant television screens of all sizes. Many of its inhabitants are based off of traditional Japanese styles and caricatures.

Snow Zone.name: Snow Zone
Snow Zone.introduce: The Snow Zone (スノーゾーン Sunō Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.

Sweets Zone.name: Sweets Zone
Sweets Zone.introduce: The Sweets Zone (スイーツゾーン Suītsu Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Sweets Zone.description: A Zone filled with candies and sugar. This Zone is known for its sugary landscape.

Sword Zone.name: Sword Zone
Sword Zone.introduce: The Sword Zone (ソードソード Sōdo Zōn) is a Zone within the Digital World.
Sword Zone.description: This Zone has a great sword in its center.

Vampire Land.name: Vampire Land
Vampire Land.introduce: Vampire Land (ヴァンパイアランド Vanpaia Rando) is a Land within the Digital World.

Amaterasu Server.name: Amaterasu Server
Amaterasu Server.introduce: Amaterasu Server (アマテラス・サーバ Amaterasu Sāba) is a server in the Digital World of Digimon World 3.

Central Sector (Amaterasu Server).name: Central Sector (Amaterasu Server)
Central Sector (Amaterasu Server).introduce: Central Sector (ちゅうおうセクター Chūou Sekutā) is the central sector of Amaterasu Server.

Central Park.name: Central Park
Central Park.introduce: Central Park (セントラル・パーク Sentoraru Pāku) is the park right outside of Asuka City in the Central Sector of Asuka Server.
Central Park.description: Central Park lies right in the center of Central Sector, and is the first outdoor area that players of Digimon Online explores. Central Park leads to Plug Cape to the west, Shell Beach to the south, and Wire Forest Entrance to the east. A big monument of sort lies in the middle of the park, and a training gym can be found on the western side of the park, near Asuka Bridge. A diving spot can be found on the southeastern part of the park, and several holes can be spotted on the ground.

Plug Cape.name: Plug Cape
Plug Cape.introduce: Plug Cape (プラグ・ケープ Puragu Kēpu) is a cape in the Central Sector of Asuka Server.

Shell Beach.name: Shell Beach
Shell Beach.introduce: Shell Beach (シェル・ビーチ Sheru Bīchi) is a beach in the Central Sector of Asuka Server.
Shell Beach.description: Shell Beach is a beach to the south of Central Park. It has many coconut trees, and many big conch shells are placed on the beach. Many banana canoes are placed here as well. Of note is a grand piano and a piano chair in the shape of shells in the middle of the beach up on the shore. The beach is a popular fishing spot for new players of Digimon Online.

Wire Forest Entrance.name: Wire Forest Entrance

Kanji/Kana.content: ワイヤのもり・いりぐち

Wire Forest Entrance.introduce: Wire Forest Entrance (ワイヤのもり・いりぐち Waiya no Mori - Iriguchi) is a forest to the east of Central Park in the Central Sector of Asuka Server.
Wire Forest Entrance.description: Wire Forest Entrance lies to the east of Central Park, and serves as the entrance to Wire Forest. What appears to be a giant submarine in the shape of a watermelon is anchored in a lake, next to a dog house. The trees near the entrance of Central Park is cut down and in the process of being sharpened by a giant pencil sharpener.

East Sector (Amaterasu Server).name: East Sector (Amaterasu Server)
East Sector (Amaterasu Server).introduce: East Sector (ひがしセクター Higashi Sekutā) is the eastern sector of Amaterasu Server.

Wire Forest.name: Wire Forest
Wire Forest.introduce: Wire Forest (ワイヤのもり Waiya no Mori) is a forest in the East Sector of Asuka Server.
Wire Forest.description: Wire Forest is a forest which serves as the entrance to the East Sector from the Central Sector. The western part of the forest has huge AV cables winding inwards from the surrounding trees, as well as a lake with a faucet towards the southwest. The eastern part of the forest has many wires protruding out of the ground and from the sides of the cliffs. There is also an inn built around a huge tree, giving a place to rest for travelers going through the forest. One can travel deeper into the forest to reach Protocol Forest, or towards the east which leads to Hangyomon's Pond.

Protocol Forest.name: Protocol Forest
Protocol Forest.introduce: Protocol Forest (プロトコルのもり Purotokoru no Mori) is a forest in the East Sector of Asuka Server.
Protocol Forest.description: Deep within the Wire Forest lies the Protocol Forest. It is filled with trees spun with the spider webs of Dokugumon, and has trees with leaves so thick that one can barely see themselves while traversing through the forest. By navigating through the forest, one can reach the Protocol Ruins, which is decorated with sphinx and serpent statues on the side of the stairs leading up to the ruins, and a monolith at the bottom of the stairs.

Protocol Ruins.name: Protocol Ruins
Protocol Ruins.introduce: Protocol Ruins (プロトコルのいせき Purotokoru no Iseki) is a ruins within Protocol Forest.
Protocol Ruins.description: Protocol Ruins stand within Protocol Forest, only reachable to those who would traverse through the forest's thick leaves. The ruins is a labyrinth of narrow paths supported by countless columns reaching up from the abyss, eventually leading to a giant floating structure with a long path of stairs. At the apex stands Pharaohmon, who is charged with guarding the ruins, and will challenge Tamers to a fight.

Hangyomon's Pond.name: Hangyomon's Pond
Hangyomon's Pond.introduce: Hangyomon's Pond (ハンギョモンのいけ Hangyomon no Ike, dub: Divermon's Lake) is a pond in the East Sector of Asuka Server.
Hangyomon's Pond.description: Hangyomon's Pond is, as its name suggests, a pond inhabited by several Hangyomon. It leads to Wire Forest to the west and Wind Prairie to the east. One can travel to the home of these Hangyomon if they are able to dive underwater. There are many abandoned shells scattered around the area, including those of several Shakomon, Shellmon, and even Zudomon. One can see a giant version of Hangyomon's spear, Torrent, lying on the western side of the bridge, and Zudomon's hammer, the Thor Hammer, stuck in the collapsed post on the eastern end of the bridge. The wires from Wire Forest can also be seen plugged in to an outlet. Two canisters with Hangyomon prints can also be found, next to two stacks of hay.

Card Island.name: Card Island
Card Island.introduce: Card Island (カード・アイランド Kādo Airando, dub: Duel Island) is an island off the northern coast in the East Sector of Asuka Server.

Wind Prairie.name: Wind Prairie
Wind Prairie.introduce: Wind Prairie (かぜのそうげん Kaze no Sougen) is a prairie in the East Sector of Asuka Server.

Qinglong City.name: Qinglong City
Qinglong City.introduce: Qinglong City (チンロン・シティ Chinron Shiti) is the city in the East Sector of Amaterasu Server.
Qinglong City.description: Qinglong City is a wind-powered city on top of the grassy plateau of a mountain, and can be reached via a path through a cave opening in Wind Prairie. Wind no longer blows in Amaterasu Server, and thus none of the windmills move. It consists of three towers, with each one bigger than the last: Gale Tower, which is completely empty; Zephyr Tower, which serves as a hotel and shop for the city; and Qinglong Tower, where a Digimon Lab and the Qinglong Chief can be found.

Kicking Forest.name: Kicking Forest
Kicking Forest.introduce: Kicking Forest (ケレルのもり Kereru no Mori) is a forest in the East Sector of Asuka Server.

Tyrano Valley.name: Tyrano Valley
Tyrano Valley.introduce: Tyrano Valley (ティラノ・バレー Tirano Barē, dub: Tyranno Valley) is a valley in the East Sector of Asuka Server.
Tyrano Valley.description: Tyrano Valley is a valley to the north of Kicking Forest. Ladders and dinosaur bones form paths which eventually leads to a dinosaur skull on the top of the valley. In the mouth of the skull is a throne from which Master Tyranomon watches over the valley and awaits challengers. It will grant an Old Claw to those who defeats it, which will allow the bearer to challenge Seiryu Leader to battle.

East Station.name: East Station
East Station.introduce: East Station (ひがしステーション Higashi Sutēshon) is a station in the East Sector of Asuka Server.
East Station.description: The East Station connects to the South Station in the South Sector via a gondola, which requires a Blue Card to gain access.

Deeper Crack.name: Deeper Crack

Kanji/Kana.content: ディーパー・クラック

Deeper Crack.introduce: Deeper Crack (ディーパー・クラック Dīpā Kurakku, dub: Deeper Crevice) is a crevice in the East Sector of Asuka Server.
Deeper Crack.description: Deeper Crack is the crevice which connects the East Station to the South Station, allowing gondolas to transport players between the East Sector and the South Sector.

North Sector (Amaterasu Server).name: North Sector (Amaterasu Server)
North Sector (Amaterasu Server).introduce: North Sector (きたセクター Kita Sekutā) is the northern sector of Amaterasu Server.

Legendary Gym.name: Legendary Gym
Legendary Gym.introduce: Lake of Ice (でんせつのジム Densetsu no Jimu) is a gym in the deepest northwestern part of the North Sector of Asuka Server.

Lake of Ice.name: Lake of Ice

Wire Forest (Amaterasu Server).description: Wire Forest is a forest which serves as the entrance to the East Sector from the Central Sector. The western part of the forest has huge AV cables winding inwards from the surrounding trees, as well as a lake with a faucet towards the southwest. The eastern part of the forest has many wires protruding out of the ground and from the sides of the cliffs. There is also an inn built around a huge tree, giving a place to rest for travelers going through the forest. One can travel deeper into the forest to reach Protocol Forest, or towards the east which leads to Hangyomon's Pond.

Asuka Server.description: Asuka Server is one of five servers for the online game Digimon Online「デジモン・オンライン Dejimon Onrain」. It is in the form of an island which is divided into five sectors of differing terrain and climate. The goal of players for Digimon Online is to travel around the server, defeating each leader situated in the city of each of the four surrounding sectors, in order to become the Server Champ and be qualified in the tournament between the five Server Champs to determine the top player of the entire game.

East Sector (Asuka Server).description: East Sector is the first of the four major sectors of Asuka Server that players of Digimon Online will explore. It is full of forests and fields, and has a generally peaceful climate similar to Central Sector. It is bordered by mountains to the north, and leads to South Sector to the south via gondola over the Deeper Crack.

Seiryu City.name: Seiryu City
Seiryu City.introduce: Seiryu City (セイリュウ・シティ Seiryū Shiti) is the city in the East Sector of Asuka Server.
Seiryu City.description: Seiryu City is a wind-powered city on top of the grassy plateau of a mountain, and can be reached via a path through a cave opening in Wind Prairie. It consists of three towers, with each one bigger than the last: Gale Tower, which houses an Airdramon; Zephyr Tower, which serves as a hotel and shop for the city; and Seiryu Tower, where a Digimon Lab and the Seiryu Leader can be found.

Antorai Shipwreck.description: Antorai Shipwreck is a shipwreck that ran aground on the beach near Tocol Swamp.

Byte Island.name: Byte Island
Byte Island.introduce: Byte Island (バイト島 Baito Tou) is an island in the Digital World.

Rimet Dunes.name: Rimet Dunes
Rimet Dunes.introduce: Rimet Dunes (リメ砂丘 Rime Sakyū) is located on the southeastern portion of Byte Island.
Rimet Dunes.description: Rimet Dunes are sand dunes which extend as far as eyes can see in the southeastern portion of Byte Island.

Tocol Swamp.name: Tocol Swamp
Tocol Swamp.introduce: Tocol Swamp (トコール沼 Tokōru Numa) is located on the southwestern portion of Byte Island.
Tocol Swamp.description: Tocol Swamp is a bottomless swamp located on a small island offshore from the southwestern portion of Byte Island.

Raster Skyscraper.name: Raster Skyscraper
Raster Skyscraper.introduce: Raster Skyscraper (ラスタ摩天楼 Rasuta Matenrou) is located at the center of Byte Island.
Raster Skyscraper.description: Raster Skyscraper is a cluster of high-rise buildings which have become ruins.

Toashisu Cave.name: Toashisu Cave
Toashisu Cave.introduce: Toashisu Cave (トアシス洞窟 Toashisu Doukutsu) is located in the northwestern portion of Byte Island.
Toashisu Cave.description: Toashisu Cave is a cave within the gaping opening beneath the cliff on the northwestern part of the island.

Thiry Canyon.name: Thiry Canyon
Thiry Canyon.introduce: Thiry Canyon (ティリ峡谷 Tiri Kyoukoku) is located in the northwestern portion of Byte Island.

Rukon Jungle.name: Rukon Jungle
Rukon Jungle.introduce: Rukon Jungle (ルーコン密林 Rūkon Mitsurin) is located in the northeastern portion of Byte Island.

Ptolon Shrine.name: Ptolon Shrine
Ptolon Shrine.introduce: Ptolon Shrine (プトロン神殿 Putoron Shinden) is located in the northeastern portion of Byte Island.

Ptolon Underground Shrine.name: Ptolon Underground Shrine
Ptolon Underground Shrine.introduce: Ptolon Underground Shrine (プトロン地下神殿 Putoron Chika Shinden) is located beneath the Ptolon Shrine.

Demon's Valley.name: Demon's Valley
Demon's Valley.introduce: Demon's Valley (デモンズバレー Demonzu Barē) is a valley within the unknown island which surfaced in the middle of the Digital World.

Dark City.name: Dark City
Dark City.introduce: Dark City (ダークシティ Dāku Shiti) is a city in the Giga Area of Digi-Land.
Dark City.description: A city with a building in the shape of a skull being grabbed by a hand and surrounded by spikes, all in black. In the main game, Wormmon uses this City to fight the player in all his evolved forms, followed by his Partner, Ichijouji Ken (as the Digimon Kaiser). In the postgame, Vamdemon opens the Haunted Arena here to recruit people to search for his beloved.

Battle Cafe (バトルカフェ Batoru Kafe).name: Battle Cafe (バトルカフェ Batoru Kafe)

Battle Arena (バトルアリーナ Batoru Arīna).name: Battle Arena (バトルアリーナ Batoru Arīna)

Deserted Island.name: Deserted Island
Deserted Island.introduce: Deserted Island is an island in the Giga Area of Digi-Land. It unlocks only after the credits roll.
Deserted Island.description: An island with a single rock tower. Dark City and Pyramid City can be seen from it. Since it's deserted, a group of troublemaking Digimon that were defeated by the Digimon Adventure Chosen Children in the past took residence here.

Giga Area.name: Giga Area
Giga Area.introduce: Giga Area (ギガエリア Giga Eria, dub name Giga Domain) is the eastern area of Digi-Land.
Giga Area.description: Giga Area is the next area the player explores after Mega Area. It leads to Tera Area to the northwest, and back to Mega Area to the southwest.

Pyramid City.name: Pyramid City
Pyramid City.introduce: Pyramid City (ピラミッドシティ Piramiddo Shiti) is a city in the Giga Area of Digi-Land.
Pyramid City.description: A city composed of two big pyramids. Sky City can be seen from it. In the postgame, it possesses an Extra Arena for Patamon's evolved levels.

Sky City.name: Sky City
Sky City.introduce: Sky City (スカイシティ Sukai Shiti) is a city in the Giga Area of Digi-Land.
Sky City.description: An arabian-style castle that floats over the clouds. In the postgame, it possesses an Extra Arena for Tailmon and her evolved levels.

Fusion Shop (ごうせいショップ Gousei Shoppu).name: Fusion Shop (ごうせいショップ Gousei Shoppu)

Player's Room (プレイヤーズルーム Pureiyāzu Rūmu).name: Player's Room (プレイヤーズルーム Pureiyāzu Rūmu)

Beginner City.name: Beginner City
Beginner City.introduce: Beginner City (ビギナシティ Bigina Shiti) is a city in the Mega Area of Digi-Land.
Beginner City.description: The first city the player arrives into when he enters Digi-Land. It has an Arena in its center, with a satellite antenna close to it. Flame City and Sage Tower can be seen from it, despite the latter being far away. It has both the very first and very last Battle Arenas of the game.

Flame City.name: Flame City
Flame City.introduce: Flame City (フレイムシティ Fureimu Shiti) is a city in the Mega Area of Digi-Land.
Flame City.description: A city with a holed-up volcano in it, which has a giant pan on top of it. In the postgame, XV-mon sets up the Extra Arena for his evolved stages in it.

Igloo City.name: Igloo City
Igloo City.introduce: Igloo City (かまくらシティ Kamakura Shiti) is a city in the Mega Area of Digi-Land.
Igloo City.description: A city with an igloo surrounded by snow and mountains. When the player first arrives in it, the Battle Arena was taken over by Stingmon, with its Battle Master, Garurumon, brainwashed by the Digimon Kaiser. The player beat Stingmon and released Garurumon. In the postgame, Armadimon sets up an Extra Arena for his evolved forms in it.

Jungle City.name: Jungle City
Jungle City.introduce: Jungle City (ジャングルシティ Janguru Shiti) is a city in the Mega Area of Digi-Land.
Jungle City.description: A city with a big trunk holed up to serve as its Battle Cafe or Arena. When the player first arrives in it, the Battle Arena was taken over by Wormmon, with its Battle Master, V-dramon, brainwashed by the Digimon Kaiser. The player beat Wormmon and released V-dramon. In the postgame, Herakle Kabuterimon sets up the Beet Arena and Hawkmon sets up an Extra Arena for his evolved forms in it.

Beet Arena (ビートアリーナ Bīto Arīna).name: Beet Arena (ビートアリーナ Bīto Arīna)

Junk City.name: Junk City
Junk City.introduce: Junk City (ジャンクシティ Janku Shiti) is a city in the Mega Area of Digi-Land.
Junk City.description: A city with a big robot in a bad state surrounded by trees and the sea. The first time the player arrives in it, its Battle Arena was taken over by Shadramon, though he was able to beat him and return it to its original Battle Master, Great King Scumon. Unlike the previous times this happened, Great King Scumon was not being controlled by the Digimon Kaiser, and was merely beaten and had his place taken from him.

Battle Arena (バトルアリ－ナ Batoru Arīna).name: Battle Arena (バトルアリ－ナ Batoru Arīna)

Mega Area.name: Mega Area
Mega Area.introduce: Mega Area (メガエリア Mega Eria, dub name Mega Domain) is the southwestern area of Digi-Land.
Mega Area.description: Mega Area is the first area the player explores. It leads to Giga Area to the east.

Infinity Tower.name: Infinity Tower
Infinity Tower.introduce: Infinity Tower (ムゲンタワー Mugen Tawā) is the tower at the center of Digi-Land, located in the Tera Area.
Infinity Tower.description: A massive black tower with circuits all over it and lights coming out of it. Several evil Digimon took residence in Infinity Tower, and wish to spread darkness throughout the world.

Sage Tower.name: Sage Tower
Sage Tower.introduce: Sage Tower (けんじゃのとう Kenja no Tou, dub name Wiseman's Tower) is a tower in the Tera Area of Digi-Land.
Sage Tower.description: A tower with a gleaming crystal on top, surrounded by light. It's the final challenge for any Card Tamer, and winning here awards them the title of Battle Master. The Battle Arena is exclusively staffed by the Partner Digimon of Digimon Adventure in various evolution levels.

Steep Road.name: Steep Road
Steep Road.introduce: Steep Road (スティープロード Sutīpu Rōdo) is a location in the Tera Area of the Digital World.
Steep Road.description: A wild road that serves as the last stop before Sage Tower. It has one cabin in it as its Battle Cafe but nothing else.

Tera Area.name: Tera Area
Tera Area.introduce: Tera Area (テラエリア Tera Eria, dub name Tera Domain) is the northwestern area of Digi-Land.
Tera Area.description: Tera Area is the third area the player explores. Infinity Tower can be reached in this area. Tera Area leads back to the Giga Area towards the east.

Digi-Land.name: Digi-Land
Digi-Land.introduce: Digi-Land (デジランド Dejirando) is an island in the Digital World.

Digital World.name: Digital World
Digital World.introduce: The "Digital World" (デジタルワールド, Dejitaru Wārudo) and "Digimon World" (デジモンワールド, Dejimon Wārudo) are names often used to refer to the many Digital Worlds that exist across all media, but it's also the default name for the Digital World ruled by the Host Computer Yggdrasill, one of the three main Digital Worlds known.[1]

Server Continent.name: Server Continent
Server Continent.introduce: Server Continent (サーバ大陸 Sāba Tairiku) is a continent in the Digital World.
Server Continent.description: The Server Continent is a large continent in the Digital World. A vast majority of it is a desert, run by Etemon.

File Island.name: File Island
File Island.introduce: File Island (ファイル島, Fairu Tou) is a massive island in the Digital World that is broken up into smaller areas with vastly differing landscapes.
File Island.description: An island broken into vastly differing landscapes, it varies from Digital World to Digital World.

Folder Continent.name: Folder Continent
Folder Continent.introduce: Folder Continent (フォルダ大陸 Foruda Tairiku) is a continent more than twice the size of File Island in the Digital World.

Forest of the Gods.name: Forest of the Gods
Forest of the Gods.introduce: Forest of the Gods (神の森 Kami no Mori) is a mysterious island consisting of forests in the northern part of the Digital World.

WWW Continent.name: WWW Continent
WWW Continent.introduce: WWW Continent (WWW大陸 Uebu Tairiku, meaning Web Continent) is the biggest continent in the Digital World.

Trash Hole.name: Trash Hole
Trash Hole.introduce: Trash Hole (トラッシュホール Torasshu Hōru) lies within the crater in the middle of the unknown island which surfaced in the middle of the Digital World.

Digital World (concept).name: Digital World (concept)
Digital World (concept).introduce: A Digital World (デジタルワールド, Dejitaru Wārudo) is huge world that exists in a different dimension than the Reality in which human beings live. It is assumed that the all existence is reduced to data in this huge digital space, and because no one can see the entirety of all the Digital World, its existence still remains a mystery.[1]

Digital World (Seekers).name: Digital World (Seekers)
Digital World (Seekers).introduce: In Digimon Seekers and media in the same setting, the Digital World (デジタルワールド Dejitaru Wārudo) is a world that exists in the internet, even deeper than the Dark Web, under the Net Ocean. It is divided into Surface and Deep Digital Worlds, separated by the Wall that doesn't allow any data that has had contact with humans through.

Digital World (Tamers).name: Digital World (Tamers)
Digital World (Tamers).introduce: In the earliest stages of its existence, this incarnation of the Digital World was little more than a barren desert. As it grew alongside the Earth's communications network, however, it evolved and changed in dynamic ways, with more and more "layers" coming into existence over the top of the old ones. The lowest layer is the original desert plain, and the highest is the home of the Four Holy Beasts that rule the Digital World. In between lie many small miniverses, self-contained environments specially suited to the Digimon that live there, including (but not limited to) an area of clouds and clockwork; a warped, black-and-white town; an area of forests, lakes and rivers; and a world entirely composed of water that contains the Digital World's database.

Digital World: Shambala.name: Digital World: Shambala
Digital World: Shambala.introduce: Digital World: Shambala (デジタルワールド・シャンバラ, Dejitaru Wārudo: Shanbara), also known as the Eastern Digital World (東方のデジタルワールド, Tōhō no Dejitaru Wārudo) or simply Shambala (シャンバラ, Shanbara), is a Digital World that exists on a different server to the Digital World ruled over by Yggdrasill or Digital World: Iliad ruled over by Homeros and is managed by the Tentei Hachibushu. It is a digital world consisting of a floating continent and small islands in the ocean of the internet. It is heavily influenced by data from the East Asia region in the real world, and the Digimon that inhabit it have undergone various evolutionary changes unique to Shambala to adapt to the environment.[1]

Witchelny.name: Witchelny
Witchelny.introduce: Witchelny (ウィッチェルニー, Wiccherunī), also known as World of Medieval Magic (中世魔術の世界, Chūsei Majutsu no Sekai), is the Digital World of another dimension.[1][2][3][4][5] It is named after the main setting of Magical Witches, a series of magic book-shaped virtual pets released by Bandai in 1998, as well as being a project that Watanabe Kenji was involved in.

Dark Area.name: Dark Area
Dark Area.introduce: The Dark Area (ダークエリア, Dāku Eria), also known as Hell[1] (地獄, Jigoku) and the Underworld[2] (冥界, Meikai), is a jet-black, abyssal "graveyard of deleted data"[3] located within a spatial distortion of the Digital World[4], below the Dark Web, the deepest part of the Net Ocean, and is the place where Leviamon sleeps[5].

Archive Port.name: Archive Port
Archive Port.introduce: Archive Port (アーカイブポート Ākaibu Pōto) is a port in Directory Continent.
Archive Port.description: Archive Port is the port of a huge ship that many people had used to ride to File Island in the past.

Boot Hole.name: Boot Hole
Boot Hole.introduce: Boot Hole (ブート・ホール Būto Hōru, dub name Boot Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.
Boot Hole.description: Boot Hole is the first hole that Akira visited, for his training exam's final assignment. There is not a single wild Beast within this hole during his first visit. The Boss of this Hole is Leomon.

Buffer Hole.name: Buffer Hole
Buffer Hole.introduce: Buffer Hole (バッファ・ホール Baffa Hōru, dub name MODEM Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.

Bug Bug Hole.name: Bug Bug Hole
Bug Bug Hole.introduce: Bug Bug Hole (バグバグ・ホール Bagu Bagu Hōru, dub name Bug Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.

Decode Hole.name: Decode Hole
Decode Hole.introduce: Decode Hole (デコード・ホール Dekōdo Hōru, dub name Laser Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.

Device Dome.name: Device Dome
Device Dome.introduce: Device Dome (デバイスドーム Debaisu Dōmu) is a location in Directory Continent.
Device Dome.description: Device Dome is a dome that was created by the people who had fled during Crimson's revolt. Many engineers are currently living here.

Black Sword (ブラックソード Burakku Sōdo).name: Black Sword (ブラックソード Burakku Sōdo)

Blue Falcon (ブルーファルコン Burū Farukon).name: Blue Falcon (ブルーファルコン Burū Farukon)

Colosseum (コロシアム Koroshiamu, dub: Colise.name: Colosseum (コロシアム Koroshiamu, dub: Coliseum)

Digimon Center (デジモンセンター Dejimon Sentā).name: Digimon Center (デジモンセンター Dejimon Sentā)

Main Gate (メインゲート Mein Gēto).name: Main Gate (メインゲート Mein Gēto)

Silver Cross (シルバークロス Shirubā Kurosu, du.name: Silver Cross (シルバークロス Shirubā Kurosu, dub: Gold Hawk)

Tamer Club (テイマークラブ Teimā Kurabu, dub: T.name: Tamer Club (テイマークラブ Teimā Kurabu, dub: Tamer's Club)

Directory Continent.name: Directory Continent
Directory Continent.introduce: Directory Continent (ディレクトリ大陸 Direkutori Tairiku) is a continent in the Digital World.
Directory Continent.description: Directory Continent is a very large landmass in the Digital World and is home to both Digimon and a digital race of humans. The continent is covered with strange dungeons referred to as Holes (dub: Domains) that burrow deep into the earth and are filled with wild Digimon and obstacles such as traps and acid swamps. They can be extremely dangerous, and vehicles called DigiBeetles were developed to traverse them.

Meridin Dome.name: Meridin Dome
Meridin Dome.introduce: Meridin Dome (メリディンドーム Meridin Dōmu, dub name Meditation Dome) is a location in Directory Continent.

Shuttle Port.name: Shuttle Port
Shuttle Port.introduce: Shuttle Port (シャトルポート Shatoru Pōto) is a port in Directory Continent.

Serial Hole.name: Serial Hole
Serial Hole.introduce: Serial Hole (シリアル・ホール Shiriaru Hōru, dub name SCSI Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.
Serial Hole.description: Serial Hole is the first hole that Akira visited after receiving Digimon. There are all types of Digimon in this hole.

Plotter Hole.name: Plotter Hole
Plotter Hole.introduce: Plotter Hole (プロッタ・ホール Purotta Hōru, dub name Video Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.
Plotter Hole.description: The boss of Plotter Hole Kokatorimon joined forces with the boss of Resist Hole, Numemon to launch a combined attack on Digital City. Plotter Hole is a hole with mainly Vaccine-type Digimon.

Resist Hole.name: Resist Hole
Resist Hole.introduce: Resist Hole (レジスト・ホール Rejisuto Hōru, dub name Disk Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.
Resist Hole.description: The boss of Resist Hole Numemon joined forces with the boss of Plotter Hole, Kokatorimon to launch a combined attack on Digital City. Numemon kidnapped Angemon to blackmail the Digimon of Meridin Dome into attacking Digital City. Plotter Hole is a hole with mainly Virus-type Digimon.

Packet Hole.name: Packet Hole
Packet Hole.introduce: Packet Hole (パケット・ホール Paketto Hōru, dub name BIOS Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.
Packet Hole.description: Packet Hole is a newly discovered and unexplored Hole, it is ruled by it's Boss Digimon Centarumon. Plotter Hole is a hole with mainly Data-type Digimon.

Dynamo Hole.name: Dynamo Hole
Dynamo Hole.introduce: Dynamo Hole (ダイナモ・ホール Dainamo Hōru, dub name Drive Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.
Dynamo Hole.description: Dynamo Hole is a hole with mainly Vaccine-type Digimon.

Proxy Hole.name: Proxy Hole
Proxy Hole.introduce: Proxy Hole (プロキシ・ホール Purokishi Hōru, dub name Web Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.
Proxy Hole.description: Proxy Hole is a hole with mainly Virus-type Digimon.

Old Hole.name: Old Hole
Old Hole.introduce: Old Hole (オールド・ホール Ōrudo Hōru, dub name DVD Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.

Ergono Hole.name: Ergono Hole
Ergono Hole.introduce: Ergono Hole (アーゴノ・ホール Āgono Hōru, dub name CODE Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.

Spool Hole.name: Spool Hole
Spool Hole.introduce: Spool Hole (スプール・ホール Supūru Hōru, dub name RAM Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.

Freeze Hole.name: Freeze Hole
Freeze Hole.introduce: Freeze Hole (フリーズ・ホール Furīzu Hōru, dub name ROM Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.

Great Hole.name: Great Hole
Great Hole.introduce: Great Hole (グレート・ホール Gurēto Hōru, Dub: Tera Domain) is a location in Directory Continent.
Great Hole.description: Great Hole is the final Hole in the game that is only unlocked after Overlord GAIA is defeated. It has 99 Floors and has no boss.

Amida Forest.name: Amida Forest
Amida Forest.introduce: Amida Forest (あみだの森 Amida no Mori, also Lott Woods) is a peculiar forest that serves as the entrance to the Ancient Dino Region from Tropical Jungle.
Amida Forest.description: Amida Forest is a peculiar forest with many stone walls and seemingly three straight paths, giving many places for one to make turns. The height of the stone walls provide slight cover from gunfire, but they also serve to make the forest look more like a maze. It also serves as the only entrance to the Ancient Dino Region.

Ancient Bone Swamp.name: Ancient Bone Swamp
Ancient Bone Swamp.introduce: Ancient Bone Swamp (古代骨の沼 Kodaihone no Numa) is a swamp on the east of Signpost Woods, where the Ancient Dino Region once was.
Ancient Bone Swamp.description: Ancient Bone Swamp an impressive swamp held together symbolically by giant skeleton data. There are many pits in the swamp where Digimon can fall in and get stuck. The Ancient Bone Swamp leads to Signpost Woods towards the west, the Underground Waterway Labyrinth towards the northwest, and Night Canyon towards the north.

Dinosaur's Ribcage (竜の肋骨 Ryū no Rokkotsu.name: Dinosaur's Ribcage (竜の肋骨 Ryū no Rokkotsu)

Ancient Dino Region.introduce: Ancient Dino Region (ダイノ古代境 Daino Kodaikyou) is a humid area on the eastern portion of File Island inhabited by many dinosaur-type Digimon.
Ancient Dino Region.description: Beyond the Amida Forest of Tropical Jungle is the Ancient Dino Region, which is divided into the Glacial Time Zone and the Speedy Time Zone. The entrance and the outside parts of Ancient Dino Region is considered Glacial Time Zone, whereas the deeper and more desolate parts of it is considered Speedy Time Zone. Time passes by at different rates in these two areas.

Glacial Time Zone.name: Glacial Time Zone
Glacial Time Zone.introduce: Glacial Time Zone (ダイノ古代境時静域 Daino Kodaikyou Jisei'iki) is the entrance and first half of Ancient Dino Region.
Glacial Time Zone.description: In the Glacial Time Zone, time passes much more slowly. Its effect is demonstrated on ancient Digimon such as Brachimon and Monochromon, who reside here. The water around the area is murky, but is extremely still. One can feel the calmness in the atmosphere just by being there.

Speedy Time Zone.name: Speedy Time Zone
Speedy Time Zone.introduce: Speedy Time Zone (ダイノ古代境時急域 Daino Kodaikyou Jikyūiki) is the deeper part and the other half of Ancient Dino Region.
Speedy Time Zone.description: In the Speedy Time Zone, time passes much more quickly. This causes the environment to decay way faster, causing the environment to look very desolate and gray. The huge dinosaur bone also serve as an example of how even something that great can decay so badly that it now serves as a tunnel. The Saberdramon around the area further add to the desolate atmosphere of the Speedy Time Zone. The meteor landing site is in the deepest part of the zone, through a hidden passageway.

Bone Tunnel (骨トンネル Hone Tonneru).name: Bone Tunnel (骨トンネル Hone Tonneru)

Entrance (古代境入口 Kodaikyou Iriguchi, mean.name: Entrance (古代境入口 Kodaikyou Iriguchi, meaning Ancient Region Entrance)

Archive Ship.name: Archive Ship
Archive Ship.introduce: Archive Ship (アーカイブシップ Ākaibu Shippu) is located in Beetle Land of File Island.
Archive Ship.description: Archive Ship is a huge ship that people had used to ride to File Island from Directory Continent's Archive Port in the past. Now its presence is treated as a legend. The ship actually used to be a turtle Digimon, but now it has all but become scrap metal.

Beetle Land.introduce: Beetle Land (ビートランド Bīto Rando) is a forest on the other side of Dragon Eye Lake on File Island.
Beetle Land.description: Beetle Land is a land where most insect Digimon reside, and can only be reached by sailing across the Dragon Eye Lake from Unwavering Forest. There is a special Colosseum which holds tournaments once every month.

Bias Hole.name: Bias Hole
Bias Hole.introduce: Bias Hole (バイアス・ホール Baiasu Hōru, dub name Mega Domain) is located in the Overdell Cemetery of File Island.

Binary Castle.name: Binary Castle
Binary Castle.introduce: Binary Castle (バイナリキャッスル Bainari Kyassuru) is a castle on the northern portion of File Island, where Misty Trees and Toy Town once was.
Binary Castle.description: Binary Castle is a sacred castle where only the strongest of Digimon reside. There are many monitor screens on the columns and walls of the castle, with their power cords strewn across the floor. There are also forbidden switches which can alter the very time passage of the Digital World. Several Royal Knights have been seen appearing in the castle, guarding these switches. In the deepest room of the castle is a throne with a statue sitting on it. Binary Castle leads to Powdery Cliff towards the east, and Boncano Volcano towards the west.

Boncano Volcano.name: Boncano Volcano
Boncano Volcano.introduce: Boncano Volcano (ボンケーノ火山 Bonkēno Kazan) is the volcano on the western portion of File Island, where Factorial Town, Trash Mountain, and Geko Swamp once was.
Boncano Volcano.description: Boncano Volcano is a hot spot of the Digital World where steel structures and the convection of overwhelming heat collide. A cave opening from Gravel Wasteland leads up to the two furnaces inside the volcano. Many warning signs are scattered about, and steel grating provides walkways to prevent Digimon from falling into the lava below. Deep within the second furnace lies the area's Memorial Stele. Boncano Volcano leads to Binary Castle towards the east through the second furnace, and Gravel Wasteland towards the south through the cave.

Chip Plains.name: Chip Plains
Chip Plains.introduce: Chip Plains (チップ平原 Chippu Heigen) is located in the southern portion of File Island.
Chip Plains.description: Chip Plains is a vast plains which spreads across the southern portion of File Island.

Cluster Hole.name: Cluster Hole
Cluster Hole.introduce: Cluster Hole (クラスタ・ホール Kurasuta Hōru, dub name Soft Domain) is located in the Misty Trees of File Island.

Coela Point.name: Coela Point

Coela Point.introduce: Coela Point (シーラ岬 Shīra Misaki, also Coela Cape) is the beach on the southern tip of Unwavering Forest of File Island.
Coela Point.description: Coela Point is the beach in Unwavering Forest, where one can see the clear blue water of the Net Ocean of the Digital World. Across from Coela Point one may barely see Naked Beach, which is the beach of Tropical Jungle.

Comber Volcano.name: Comber Volcano
Comber Volcano.introduce: Comber Volcano (コンバー火山 Konbā Kazan) is at the center of File Island.
Comber Volcano.description: Comber Volcano is a huge volcano which is located at the center of the island.

Comber Volcano Crater.name: Comber Volcano Crater
Comber Volcano Crater.introduce: Comber Volcano Crater (コンバー火山・火口 Konbā Kazan - Kakou) is the mouth of Comber Volcano.
Comber Volcano Crater.description: Comber Volcano Crater is a dangerous volcano crater which spews out lava.

Coolin Desert.name: Coolin Desert
Coolin Desert.introduce: Coolin Desert (クーリン砂漠 Kūrin Sabaku) is located in the northwestern portion of File Island.
Coolin Desert.description: Coolin Desert is the desert area which spreads across the northwestern portion of File Island.

Coupler Hole.name: Coupler Hole
Coupler Hole.introduce: Coupler Hole (カプラー・ホール Kapurā Hōru, dub name Diode Domain) is located in the Tropical Jungle of File Island.

Daion Region.name: Daion Region
Daion Region.introduce: Daion Region (ダイオン郷 Daion Kyou, a pun on daionkyou, meaning a loud sound, dub name Volume Villa) is a hidden village within the Geko Swamp.
Daion Region.description: Daion Region is located in the western part of Geko Swamp, and is usually hidden from outsiders.  There are several musical equipments at the entrance, as well as a stage.  The inner portion is the palace where Tonosama Gekomon resides.

King's Room (トノサマの間 Tonosama no Ma).name: King's Room (トノサマの間 Tonosama no Ma)

Dark Lord Mansion.introduce: Dark Lord Mansion (闇貴族の館 Yamikizoku no Yakata, also Dark Mansion, dub: Grey Lord Mansion) is a dark mansion inside the Overdell Cemetery.
Dark Lord Mansion.description: Dark Lord Mansion has an extremely dark force around it, causing only Virus-attribute Digimon to have the power to enter. The mansion is very huge, with rooms such as a long dining room, a kitchen, a bathroom, a library, a study, and a bedroom. One can also walk up to the attic, but that is not advised as some of the wiring mesh may be worn out.  Also, it is rumored to have traps within the mansion, so take caution when exploring. And there is that ONE door you can never open due to some other mysterious force...

Digimon World: Digital Card Battle

Kunemon

Digi Bridge.introduce: Digi Bridge (デジブリッジ Dejiburijji, dub: Digital Bridge) is a bridge connecting Unwavering Forest and Tropical Jungle.
Digi Bridge.description: The Digi Bridge is the bridge that will connect Unwavering Forest to Tropical Jungle once it is completed. There seems to be a direct route that connects this area with the Village of Beginnings, but apparently it is being blocked by weeds and trees. A sort of abandoned building now used for storage is near the bridge, which may be a good spot for black marketing to take place.

Dragon Eye Lake.name: Dragon Eye Lake
Dragon Eye Lake.introduce: Dragon Eye Lake (竜の目の湖 Ryuu no Me no Mizuumi, also Dragon's Lake) is a lake on the southwestern portion of File Island.
Dragon Eye Lake.description: Dragon Eye Lake is a lake in the Unwavering Forest of File Island. It is inhabited by a Seadramon. There is a small island off the shore that became disconnected when Seadramon pulled it away. Across from the island is rumored to be a land inhabited by insect Digimon, but the only way to get there is to ride across the lake.

Drill Tunnel.introduce: Drill Tunnel (ドリルトンネル Doriru Tonneru) is a tunnel in the Unwavering Forest of File Island. Another Drill Tunnel in Digimon World Re:Digitize Decode is in the Night Canyon instead.
Drill Tunnel.description: The Drill Tunnel is a three basement story tunnel built to connect the Unwavering Forest directly to the foot of Mount Panorama, which leads to the Gear Savannah directly north of that.  The Drill Tunnel is home to several Drimogemon, where they live in the Residence Ward and use the Underground Lake as a water source within the tunnel. The deeper parts of the tunnel is at an intense temperature, with lava all around. Some say that a great treasure lies deep down within the tunnel. Another Drill Tunnel appears in Digimon World Re:Digitize Decode. This one is accessed from the Night Canyon originally, and through Drimogemon's work, later expands to connect it to the Big Cauldron Chamber in the Underground Waterway Labyrinth and to Fluorescent Cave. Later on, Master Tyranomon opens the Master Bar in it.

Lava Cave.name: Lava Cave

Lava Cave.text:
Digimon World: Digital Card Battle
Meramon

Lava Cave.introduce: Lava Cave (溶岩洞 Yougandou) is the deepest part of Drill Tunnel, behind a wall at the Underground Lake.
Lava Cave.description: The Lava Cave is the deepest part of Drill Tunnel, which can be reached by drilling through the wall in the Underground Lake. Recently, a sudden rise in temperature has caused the whole cave to be engulfed mostly in lava, as well as causing landslides which blocked the road from Unwavering Forest to Outlook Mountain.

Leomon's Ancestral Cave.name: Leomon's Ancestral Cave
Leomon's Ancestral Cave.introduce: Leomon's Ancestral Cave (レオモン族の遺跡 Leomon Zoku no Iseki) is a cave deep within the Drill Tunnel on File Island.
Leomon's Ancestral Cave.description: Leomon's Ancestral Cave is where the treasure of Drill Tunnel is rumored to exist. The Drimogemon at the third basement floor of Drill Tunnel has been trying to reach this by continuously drilling every single day.

Underground Lake (地底湖 Chiteiko, also Bot.name: Underground Lake (地底湖 Chiteiko, also Bottom Lake)

Dust Kingdom.name: Dust Kingdom
Dust Kingdom.introduce: Dust Kingdom (ダストキングダム Dasuto Kingudamu) is the landfill deep inside the Trash Mountain of Gear Savannah.
Dust Kingdom.description: The Dust Kingdom is where the filthiest of trash is moved to. Eventually, it became so filthy that only Scumon reside in it. These Scumon are ruled by Great King Scumon, the king of Scumon. The Dust Kingdom is famous for its training facility made of filth, where a Digimon can train its magic powers by burrowing itself into it and enduring the smell.

Sewers.name: Sewers
Sewers.introduce: Sewers (地下下水道 Chika Gesuidou, meaning Underground Sewers) is the underground sewers within Factorial Town on File Island.
Sewers.description: The Sewers is the place where Factorial Town's waste is dumped.  It is not too big in size, and can be reached by a manhole near the center of Factorial Town.

Square (ゲート広場 Gēto Hiroba, meaning Gate.name: Square (ゲート広場 Gēto Hiroba, meaning Gate Square)

Register Grassland.name: Register Grassland
Register Grassland.introduce: Register Grassland (レジスタ草原 Rejisuta Sougen) is a grassland located around the base of Infinity Mountain on File Island.

There is a lake rumored to be the habitat of a Seadramon, and across the lake is a land where insect Digimon roam. There is also a path that leads to Outlook Mountain, but is blocked by a rock slide. Kunemon's Bed.name: Kunemon's Bed
Kunemon's Bed.introduce: Kunemon's Bed (クネモンのねどこ Kunemon no Nedoko) is a part of Unwavering Forest with a pretty big tree where Kunemon resides.
Kunemon's Bed.description: Kunemon's Bed is a somewhat big tree in Unwavering Forest where Kunemon resides. One can see Coela Point from up here, and can walk on the road south of Kunemon's Bed to reach it. The road to the north goes to Digi Bridge, though it is still incomplete.

Trash Mountain.description: The Trash Mountain is a mountain made from different kinds of trash and scraps, which results from the building and destroying of machines within the Factorial Town. Several Digimon native to such an environment hang around here. Deep within the mountain is the Dust Kingdom, home of many Scumon.

Geko Swamp.name: Geko Swamp
Geko Swamp.introduce: Geko Swamp (ゲッコー湿地 Gekkō Shicchi) is a swamp on the northwestern portion of File Island.
Geko Swamp.description: Geko Swamp is a swamp north of Gear Savannah, and leads to Misty Trees. Geko Swamp seems like any other ordinary swamp, but some say that a palace where the ruler of the swamp resides is hidden somewhere within the swamp.

In Digimon World -next 0rder-, it's part of Absolute Zero.
Ice Sanctuary.description: Completely made of ice, the Ice Sanctuary is a sight to behold. To enter and experience its beauty, only Vaccine-attribute Digimon are accepted. Once inside, one can feel the chill coming from within, but can't seem to find where it is coming from. In the middle of the sanctuary is a statue of ice, standing gracefully. However, it seems that the chilling air comes from the statue...or beneath it to be exact.

Secret Beach Cave.name: Secret Beach Cave
Secret Beach Cave.introduce: Secret Beach Cave (秘密の海岸洞 Himitsu no Kaigandou) is a cave offshore from Freezeland on File Island.
Secret Beach Cave.description: The Secret Beach Cave is the home of Whamon, and is located offshore from Freezeland. Travelers who wish to go to the cave must talk to Whamon.

Mangrove Region.introduce: Mangrove Region (マングローブ域 Mangurōbu Iki), also simply Mangrove (マングローブ Mangurōbu), is a small tropical region in the Tropical Jungle of File Island.
Mangrove Region.description: The Mangrove Region is where several Yanmamon and Modoki Betamon reside, creating an annoying atmosphere with the constant buzzing of Yanmamon, combining with the humid weather of the jungle.

MIMD Hole.introduce: MIMD Hole (ミムド・ホール Mimudo Hōru, dub name Scan Domain) is located in Factorial Town of File Island.

Noise Hole.introduce: Noise Hole (ノイズ・ホール Noizu Hōru, dub name Data Domain) is located in Great Canyon of File Island.
