Furagude Forest.introduce: Furagude Forest (フラグデの森 Furagude no Mori) is located in the western portion of File Island.
Furagude Forest.description: Furagude Forest is the forest that lies ahead of the Chip Plains.

Muro Forest.name: Muro Forest
Muro Forest.introduce: Muro Forest (ムロ樹海 Muro Jukai) is located in the southeastern portion of File Island.
Muro Forest.description: Muro Forest is a dazzling forest which bewilders all who enters it.

Reiku Iceberg.name: Reiku Iceberg
Reiku Iceberg.introduce: Reiku Iceberg (レイクウ氷山 Reikū Hyouzan) is an iceberg located in the southeastern portion of File Island.
Reiku Iceberg.description: Reiku Iceberg is an icebound region of absolute zero, located south of Muro Forest.

Giban Castle.name: Giban Castle
Giban Castle.introduce: Giban Castle (ギバン城 Giban Jyou) is a castle located in the northeastern portion of File Island.
Giban Castle.description: Giban Castle is a suspicious castle where mighty forces dwell within.

Giban Castle Outer Walls.name: Giban Castle Outer Walls
Giban Castle Outer Walls.introduce: Giban Castle Outer Walls (ギバン城外郭 Giban Jyou Gaikaku) are the outer walls of Giban Castle.
Giban Castle Outer Walls.description: Giban Castle Outer Walls are the walls of Giban Castle, shrouded in a dim fog.

Railroad Plains.name: Railroad Plains
Railroad Plains.introduce: Railroad Plains (鉄路の平原 Tetsuro no Heigen) is the plains on the southern portion of File Island, where the Unwavering Forest once was.
Railroad Plains.description: Railroad Plains is a large plains with many old trains and railways, as well as an abandoned train station in the center. A few traffic lights are scattered around, and some power lines are near the coast leading to the Submerged Ruins. Railroad Plains leads to the Village of Beginnings towards the north, the Submerged Ruins towards the south, and the Fluorescent Cave towards the west.

Signpost Woods.name: Signpost Woods
Signpost Woods.introduce: Signpost Woods (道標の森 Michishirube no Mori) is the forest on the eastern portion of File Island, where Tropical Jungle once was.
Signpost Woods.description: Signpost Woods is a forest with many signposts, gauges and pipes, and trees towering high above, blocking out most sunlight. The roots of the trees are twisted onto the pipes, creating walkways. There are also several waterfalls. Signpost Woods lead to the Village of Beginnings towards the west, the Underground Waterway Labyrinth towards the north, the Ancient Bone Swamp towards the east, and the Submerged Ruins towards the south.

Submerged Ruins.name: Submerged Ruins
Submerged Ruins.introduce: Submerged Ruins (水没の古都 Suibotsu no Koto) is a submerged ancient City on the south of the Railroad Plains. It is the original Village of Beginnings.
Submerged Ruins.description: Submerged Ruins is an ancient City that has been submerged, where most of the buildings can only be seen underwater. One must be able to literally walk on water to be able to traverse the area. The Submerged Ruins lead to the Railroad Plains towards the west, and Signpost Woods towards the east.

Underground Waterway Labyrinth.name: Underground Waterway Labyrinth
Underground Waterway Labyrinth.introduce: Underground Waterway Labyrinth (地下水路迷宮 Chikasuiromeikyū) is an underground waterway on the north of Signpost Woods, where Overdell Cemetery and the Dark Lord Mansion once was.
Underground Waterway Labyrinth.description: The Underground Waterway Labyrinth is a waterway with a structure as complex as that of a labyrinth. It is decorated with many furniture, paintings, and other high-class furnishing, suggesting that this place used to be a mansion. The Underground Waterway Labyrinth leads to Signpost Woods towards the southwest, and the Ancient Bone Swamp towards the southeast.

Fluorescent Cave.name: Fluorescent Cave
Fluorescent Cave.introduce: Fluorescent Cave (ケイコウ洞窟 Keikou Doukutsu) is a cave on the west of the Railroad Plains, where Mount Panorama and the Drill Tunnel once was.
Fluorescent Cave.description: Fluorescent Cave is a cave with shining greenery, and connects the Railroad Plains on its east to the Gravel Wasteland on its west. It is actually a giant hollow tree log with greenery growing inside. There are many different glowing plants in the cave, which gives the cave a fluorescent environment. Each part of the cave contains a different colored moss, where different kinds of plants grow. Deep within the cave is a mansion, blocked off by a large gate.

Gravel Wasteland.name: Gravel Wasteland
Gravel Wasteland.introduce: Gravel Wasteland (砂礫の荒野 Sareki no Kouya) is the wasteland on the western portion of File Island, where Gear Savannah once was.
Gravel Wasteland.description: Gravel Wasteland is a mysterious desert with ancient ruins and giant light bulbs, as well as several giant screws and some cacti. There are several ditches where the sands of the desert constantly fall into. Solid rock paths allow passage over such ditches. A cave in the northeast area leads to the area's Memorial Stele. Gravel Wasteland leads to Boncano Volcano towards the north, and the Fluorescent Cave towards the east.

Night Canyon.name: Night Canyon
Night Canyon.introduce: Night Canyon (ナイトキャニオン Naito Kyanion) is a canyon located on the eastern portion of File Island, where the Great Canyon once was.
Night Canyon.description: Night Canyon is a sensational canyon configured from thoughts surrounding nightlife and the remnants of the Real World. There are many entertainment signs and buildings around the area. Night Canyon leads to Powdery Cliff towards the northwest, and the Ancient Bone Swamp towards the south.

Powdery Cliff.name: Powdery Cliff
Powdery Cliff.introduce: Powdery Cliff (パウダリークリフ Paudarī Kurifu) is an icy location on the northern portion of File Island, where Freezeland once was.
Powdery Cliff.description: Powdery Cliff is a place completely filled with snow and ice. It looks like a magical world, but it is rejected by all living creatures due to its ruthless scenery. The area shows signs of eroded structures covered in ice, which may have been the remnants of a temple. There are many wrecked ships as well, forming passageways and crevasses. Powdery Cliff leads to Binary Castle towards the west through a path blocked by a wall of ice, and Night Canyon towards the south.

Holy Angel Castle.introduce: Holy Angel Castle (ホーリーエンジェル城 Hōrī Enjeru Jou) is a fortress located on Folder Continent.
Holy Angel Castle.description: Holy Angel Castle is a massive, walled fortress with many glass-like surfaces.

Nightmare Castle.name: Nightmare Castle
Nightmare Castle.introduce: Nightmare Castle (ナイトメア城 Naitomea Jou) is a castle ruled by Vamdemon. Once he is killed, the castle vanishes.
Nightmare Castle.description: The castle is a Gothic-looking architecture overlooking a graveyard littered with the desiccated corpses of various Digimon. A Patamon tells Taichi that the Digimon of the village became possessed and started killing each other.

Net Surf Village.name: Net Surf Village
Net Surf Village.introduce: Net Surf Village (ネットサーフ村 Netto Sāfu Mura) is a village on Folder Continent.
Net Surf Village.description: Net Surf Village rests on the beach of the Net Ocean.

Script Forest.introduce: Script Forest (スクリプトの森 Sukuriputo no Mori) is a forest within the Forest of the Gods.

Network Interstice.introduce: Network Interstice (ネットワークのはざま Nettowāku no Hazama, dub: Optical Network) is the network space between the servers of Digimon Online.

New Digital World.name: New Digital World
New Digital World.introduce: The New Digital World (NEWデジタルワールド New Dejitaru Wārudo), initialed to NDW, is a region of subspace created by the Host Computer, Yggdrasill as a result of the current Digital World reaching its maximum capacity.

Skuld Terminal.name: Skuld Terminal
Skuld Terminal.introduce: The Skuld Terminal (スクルドターミナル Sukurudo  Tāminaru) is one of the three layers or "Terminals" of the New Digital World. Its name is derived from Skuld, one of the three Norns who tended to the world tree, Yggdrasil in Norse mythology. This layer represents the future, and is filled with Artificial Evolution and Machine type Digimon.

Ulud Terminal.name: Ulud Terminal
Ulud Terminal.introduce: The Ulud Terminal (ウルドターミナル Urudo Tāminaru) is one of the three layers or "Terminals" of the New Digital World. Its name is derived from a misspelling of Urd, one of the three Norns who tended to the world tree, Yggdrasil in Norse mythology. This layer represents the past, and is filled with Ancient Digimon, including Dinosaur type Digimon.

Versandi Terminal.name: Versandi Terminal
Versandi Terminal.introduce: The Versandi Terminal (ベルサンディターミナル Berusandi Tāminaru) is one of the three layers or "Terminals" of the New Digital World. Its name is derived from a misspelling of Verthandi, one of the three Norns who tended to the world tree, Yggdrasil in Norse mythology. This layer represents the present, and is filled with many varieties of Digimon.

Assembler Tower.name: Assembler Tower
Assembler Tower.introduce: Assembler Tower (アセンブラタワー, Asenbura Tawā) is a tower on the northern part of WWW Continent.

Boot Volcano.name: Boot Volcano
Boot Volcano.introduce: Boot Volcano (ブート火山, Būto Kazan) is a volcano on the southern part of WWW Continent. Gokuwmon was born from within its boiling magma.[1]

North Bridge Island-(Assuming that it is.name: North Bridge Island-(Assuming that it is the sandy reef adjacent to the Island)

Cocytus.name: Cocytus
Cocytus.introduce: The Cocytus (コキュートス, Kokyūtosu) is is an area connected to all Dark Areas, with each Digital World having its own Dark Area. There is only one Cocytus, with the location shared by every Dark Area, with Cocytus acting as the deepest layer within each Dark Area, connecting them all to each other.[1] Grand Dracumon, Gulfmon, and the Seven Great Demon Lords have their castles and base of operations here.[1][2]

Dark Area (Witchelny).name: Dark Area (Witchelny)
Dark Area (Witchelny).introduce: Witchelny has its own Dark Area (ダークエリア "Dāku Eria"?). It is connected to the Cocytus.[1]

Golden Land.name: Golden Land
Golden Land.introduce: The Golden Land (黄金郷 Ōgonkyō) is a mysterious place in the eastern part of the Digital World, protected by multiple sacred barriers. Its said that Yatagaramon and Yatagaramon (2006 Anime Version) guides the chosen to the Golden Land, and with their help, the sacred barriers will be released, but only those who surmount the "Threefold Trials" submitted by Yatagaramon will arrive at the Golden Land. The ones who fail are dispatched to the Dark Area.[1][2]

Gurabo Continent.name: Gurabo Continent
Gurabo Continent.introduce: Gurabo Continent (グラボ大陸 Gurabo Tairiku, meaning Graphics Board Continent) is the continent in the Digital World.

History of the Digital World.name: History of the Digital World
History of the Digital World.introduce: The history of the Digital World varies with different continuities.

LACUNA.name: LACUNA
LACUNA.introduce: LACUNA (ラクーナ, Rakūna) is the virtual space where Digimon Liberator takes place. It's a cyber world formed from a complex fusion of mapping data from the real world.[1] Users can access it through a Full Dive using a Translation Another Life Engine, or T.A.L.E., metaverse pods available at amusement facilities nationwide, where they set their D-Storages and put on goggles to start the machine.[2].

Emerald Coast.name: Emerald Coast
Emerald Coast.description: The Invasive Forest City Emerald Coast (侵森都市エメラルドコースト Shinshin Toshi Emerarudo Kōsuto; Dub: Emerald Coast, the Invasive Forest City) is a vast city encroached upon by nature. It primarily features skyscrapers, but there are also places resembling Southeast Asian ruins and Japanese-style buildings, all of which are taken over by plants. It functions as a tutorial area for beginning players embarking on their first adventure, with most of the battle NPCs encountered being low-level. It's beloved by many players for its quiet atmosphere relatively peaceful setting, making it useful as a base of operations. There are two types of quest in this area: NPCs that act as conduits to the episodes of the Main Scenario's prologue are located in the Emerald Coast. One of these is Makina, a robot on the brink of shutdown who entrusts several cards to the players starting the Main Scenario, before exhausting its power.[1]

Hatsumōde Forest.description: Hatsumōde Forest (初詣の森 Hatsumōde no Mori; Dub: Shrine Forest)

Obsidian Desert.name: Obsidian Desert
Obsidian Desert.description: The Dusty Demonic Realm Obsidian Desert (塵外魔境オブシディアンデザート Jingai Makyō Obushidian Dezāto; Dub: Obsidian Desert, the Dusty Demonic Realm)

Amber Remains.name: Amber Remains
Amber Remains.description: The Time Static Domain Amber Remains (時静領域アンバーリメインズ Jisei Ryōiki Anbā Rimeinzu; Dub: Amber Remains, the Timeless Domain)

Ruby Mountain.name: Ruby Mountain
Ruby Mountain.description: The Roaring Flame Zone Ruby Mountain (轟炎地帯ルビーマウンテン Gouen Chitai Rubī Maunten; Dub: Ruby Mountain, the Inferno Zone) is a high-level area within LACUNA, located far from the central city, on the distant outskirts of the realm. No NPCs normally exist in this area. Due to the smoke and ash billowing from clusters of active volcanoes, the sky cannot be seen, the only light coming from rivers of flowing magma, casting everything in a glowing red. The dull pop of bubbles forming from the lava and the savory sizzle of the molten stone serve as makeshift background music.[5]

Amethyst City.name: Amethyst City
Amethyst City.description: The Sharp Sky Corridor Amethyst City (尖鋭天廊アメジストシティ Senei Tenrō Amejisuto Shiti; Dub: Amethyst City, the Sky Spire Corridor)

E.G.G.name: E.G.G
E.G.G.description: E.G.G (エッグ Eggu), short for Extent of Governing Ground, is an enormous computer.

Avalon.description: Debug Team Dedicated Area Avalon (デバッグチーム専用エリアアヴァロン Debaggu Chīmu Senyō Eria Avaron; Dub: Avalon, the Debugging Team's Private Area)

Link Ruins.name: Link Ruins
Link Ruins.introduce: The Link Ruins are an ancient ruin found in the deepest part of the desert. It is a habitat for holy species digimon.

Mazabo Continent.name: Mazabo Continent
Mazabo Continent.introduce: Mazabo Continent (マザボ大陸 Mazabo Tairiku, meaning Motherboard Continent) is the continent in the Digital World.

DigiBase.name: DigiBase
DigiBase.introduce: The DigiBase (デジベース, Dejibēsu) is the home base and central hub in Digimon Story: Lost Evolution. It serves as a headquarters for missions, upgrades, and managing Digimon. The base includes facilities, such as the DigiFarm, the DigiLab and a Quest PC.

Multitask City.name: Multitask City
Multitask City.introduce: Multitask City is a city which was in control of Mugendramon while the chosen children returned in Japan to take care of Vamdemon.

Ryushogu.name: Ryushogu
Ryushogu.introduce: Ryushogu (竜晶宮 Ryūshōgū, lit. "Dragon Crystal Palace") is an oceanic area in the Eastern Digital World where beautiful crystals grow. It is the peaceful ocean, which is also known as a paradise for water-dwelling Digimon, protected by Ryugumon, who has the role of purifying the ocean to its normal state.[1] It impossible to reach the secluded region without riding the ocean currents generated by Shagaramon. The Digimon responsible for gatekeeping alongside Shagaramon, who was entrusted the role by Ryugumon, are Hangyomon and Mermaimon, and Shagaramon has the additional role of supervising the other gatekeepers.[2]

Slimy Swamp.name: Slimy Swamp
Slimy Swamp.introduce: Slimy Swamp is very humid all year round. Digimon that like water and dark places live here.

Yomi.name: Yomi
Yomi.introduce: Yomi (黄泉（よみ）, Yomi) is the underworld in Digital World: Shambala that corresponds to the Dark Area of other worlds. Enmamon of the Tentei Hachibushu is stationed here. Yomi exists underground and even the living can travel there by passing through Yomotsu Hirasaka (ヨモツヒラサカ), which is connected to Ashino Island. Yomi possesses its own unique ecosystem and there are many Digimon that live only in Yomi.[1]

Hikarigaoka.name: Hikarigaoka
Hikarigaoka.introduce: Hikarigaoka (光が丘公園) is a district in the Nerima ward, and the original home of the eight Chosen Children who fought in the Digital World in 1999.

Palo Alto University.name: Palo Alto University
Palo Alto University.introduce: Palo Alto University (パロアルト大学, Paro Aruto Daigaku) is a university in California in which the Wild Bunch studied at the where the group was formed. Most of the significant breakthroughs during their research project occurred there during the 1980's, headed by Professor Rob McCoy. While the artificial intelligence project was in its infancy, Rob McCoy's son designed the Digimon, Mizuno Gorou wrote the code that allowed the Digimon to evolve, Daisy designed the devices that allowed them to communicate with the Digimon.

Real World.name: Real World
Real World.introduce: The Real World (リアルワールド, Riaru Wārudo, 現実世界, Genjitsu Sekai), also referred to as the Human World (人間界, Ningenkai) AKA Planet Earth or Material World (マテリアルワールド, Materiaru Wārudo), is a place inhabited by humans and other organisms.

Summer camp.name: Summer camp
Summer camp.introduce: In Digimon Adventure, the seven Chosen Children attend a summer camp (サマーキャンプ Samā kyanpu). During the camp, they are unexpectedly taken into the Digital World.

Absolute Zero.name: Absolute Zero
Absolute Zero.introduce: Absolute Zero (アブソリュート・ゼロ Abusoryūto Zero) is the snowy region to the north of Great Fault Ex Machina.
Absolute Zero.description: Absolute Zero is a snowy region constantly blasted by a blizzard, with an icy cathedral being the only respite from the weather. It leads to Great Fault Ex Machina towards the south.

AR-Field.name: AR-Field
AR-Field.introduce: An AR-Field (ＡＲフィールド, AR Fīrudo) is a region of space located between the Net and the Real World created by Leviathan. They resemble a ruined version of the Human World, as they are simulations of the world Leviathan will create if it manages to take over it. The AR-Fields are the only place where Appmon can materialize without apprealizing. Humans that are in an AR-Field are simply referred to as "Drivers" whereas those that have an Appli Drive and are able to generate an opening to an AR-Field are called "Appli Drivers"[1]. Damage to the AR-Field landscape can affect the Human World, such as causing power outages and inducing irregular behavior in digital appliances. In the manga continuity, there are several themed AR-fields featuring special characteristics according to the Appmon species that lives in. A Chaos AR-Field (カオスＡＲフィールド, Kaosu AR Fīrudo) version is also featured in the 3DS videogame.

Chikaino Grasslands.name: Chikaino Grasslands
Chikaino Grasslands.introduce: Chikaino Grasslands (チカイノ草原 Chikaino Sōgen) is a grasslands to the south of Floatia.
Chikaino Grasslands.description: Chikaino Grasslands is the grasslands closest to Floatia (Chikaino (近いの) means "nearby" in Japanese). It has many giant capacitators as well as hills with exposed fluorescent minerals. A cave leads to MOD Ship Cape towards the east, while Server Desert lies towards the west of the great plains.

Cyberspace EDEN.introduce: Cyberspace EDEN (電脳空間ＥＤＥＮ, Den'nō Kūkan Eden or alternatively サイバースペースエデン, Saibā Supēsu Eden) exists within the Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth games. It was created by Kamishiro Enterprises as a way to unify people and create ease of communication. People could get their own servers\parts of EDEN or use normal open areas of it. Kowloon is a subpart of EDEN in which Hackers run rampant.

DigiFarm.name: DigiFarm
DigiFarm.introduce: The DigiFarm (デジファーム, Dejifāmu) is a place that appears in the Digimon Story series where the protagonist's extra Digimon can be stored while they are not traveling with them.

DigiLab.name: DigiLab
DigiLab.introduce: The DigiLab (デジラボ, Dejirabo) is a key facility that appears in the Digimon video games series that serves as a central hub for managing the protagonist's Digimon. Its functions vary by game, but it generally allows for training, healing, and evolving Digimon. It also includes the ability to investigate the Digital World, develop new technologies, and store the protagonist's extra Digimon.

DigiQuartz.name: DigiQuartz
DigiQuartz.introduce: DigiQuartz (デジクオーツ Dejikuōtsu) is a world where time flows at a different rate to the Real World that appears in Digimon Xros Wars: The Young Hunters Who Leapt Through Time. It was created by Quartzmon from the human world's data which is why it bears a resemblance to the human world, appearing like a shadow copy.

Firewall.name: Firewall
Firewall.introduce: The Firewall (ファイアーウォール, Faiāwōru) is a defensive barrier that defends the Net.

Floatia.name: Floatia
Floatia.introduce: Floatia (フローティア, Furōtia) is the main city of Digimon World -next 0rder-/Digimon World -next 0rder- International Edition.
Floatia.description: Floatia is the main city in the Digital World, consisting of 6 districts, with many facilities in each. It leads to Chikaino Grasslands towards the south. The entrance to Infinity Cauldron lies deep beneath the city.

Gluttony Wasteland.name: Gluttony Wasteland
Gluttony Wasteland.introduce: Gluttony Wasteland (オーグィノ荒野 Ōguino Kōya; オーグィノ is a pun on 大食いの) is a wasteland to the west of Floatia.
Gluttony Wasteland.description: Gluttony Wasteland is a wasteland torn in battle between meat-loving humanoid bandit Digimon and the seemingly royal nature Digimon who prefer vegetables. The wasteland is divided into two parts by a deep canyon, only connected by a single long bridge: The humanoid Digimon's Meat Army controls the Guts Wasteland on the east, while the nature Digimon's Vegetable Army controls the Castle of Thorns on the west. The wasteland leads to Server Desert to the southeast, while the castle has paths leading to Tail Bone Resort to the west and Great Fault Ex Machina to the north.

Great Fault Ex Machina.name: Great Fault Ex Machina
Great Fault Ex Machina.introduce: Great Fault Ex Machina (大断層エクスマキナ Daidansō Ekusumakina) is a series of mechanical islands to the north of Floatia.
Great Fault Ex Machina.description: Great Fault Ex Machina is a series of mechanical islands located over a great fault, connected together by bridges that can be disconnected from a control room. Its west coast leads to Gluttony Wasteland, its east coast to MOD Ship Cape, and its north coast to Absolute Zero.

Infinity Cauldron.name: Infinity Cauldron
Infinity Cauldron.introduce: Infinity Cauldron (ムゲンコルドロン Mugen Korudoron) is the underground region deep beneath the earth underneath Floatia.
Infinity Cauldron.description: Infinity Cauldron goes from the center of the Digital World to beneath its surface, eventually reaching its core through several layers. It is comparable to the underworld, where only the most hostile Digimon reside. It can be reached once Floatia takes to the skies, leaving behind the Ruins Lake in Chikaino Grasslands, with a portal leading into the area.

Internet.name: Internet
Internet.introduce: The Internet (インターネット, Intānetto), also known as the Computer Network (コンピュータネットワーク / コンピュータのネットワーク, Konpyūta Nettowāku / Konpyūta no Nettowāku)[1][2], the Network (ネットワーク, Nettowāku)[3], the Net (ネット, Netto)[4], the Net Area (ネットエリア, Netto Eria)[5], or the Net Space (ネット空間, Netto Kūkan)[6] is the manifestation of the World Wide Web through which the Real World transmits endless quantities of information. The Digital World, a pseudo-cyberspace with similar characteristics to the Real World, was created on the Network[7], and is ruled over by the mysterious host computer Yggdrasill[8].

Logic Flame Mountain.name: Logic Flame Mountain
Logic Flame Mountain.introduce: Logic Flame Mountain (ロン・リ炎山 Ron Ri Enzan, a pun on 論理演算 Ronri Enzan meaning Logical Operations) is the fiery region to the south of Server Desert.
Logic Flame Mountain.description:
Logic Flame Mountain is a fiery mountain trail with Torii gates all over, with Nixie tubes showing numbers in seemingly random locations. It leads to Server Desert towards the north.

MOD Ship Cape.description: MOD Ship Cape is a cape with a battalion of ghastly ships called MOD Ships. The cave on its inlet cape leads to Chikaino Grasslands towards the southwest, while the docks of the Flag MOD Ship leads to Great Fault Ex Machina towards the northwest.

Never-Ever Land.name: Never-Ever Land
Never-Ever Land.introduce: Never-Ever Land (ネバーエヴァーランド, Nebā-Evā Rando) is a children's world built by Petermon[1] and Tinkermon[2], to which Petermon tempts young and childish Digimon that refuse to evolve.[1] It is based on Neverland, the homeworld of Peter Pan and Tinker Bell in the eponymous novel.

Server Desert.name: Server Desert
Server Desert.introduce: Server Desert (サーバー砂漠 Sābā Sabaku) is a desert to the southwest of Floatia.
Server Desert.description: Server Desert is a desert full of abandoned servers. It impressively has an oasis equipped with chairs, aquarium, and vending machine. It leads to Chikaino Grasslands to the east, Logic Flame Mountain to the south, and Gluttony Wasteland to the northwest.

Tail Bone Resort.description: Tail Bone Resort is a dark canyon of nightlife, with many neon buildings as well as giant bones. A graveyard with a small chapel lies deep within the canyon. It leads to Gluttony Wasteland towards the east.
